Container.Name: SumDoc
Container.Overview: SumDoc standalone: a Word-compatible browser editor (.docx round-trip) for your own system, without Nextcloud. Your system answers two URLs: an auth URL (200 for a signed-in user) and an attachment URL (file bytes by id). Edit both in Post Arguments (advanced view) before the first start.[br][br] For Nextcloud use the SumOffice template instead.[br][br] The image is free for evaluation; production use inside an organisation is licensed per application: https://sumoffice.com/download#server
Container.Requires: Your own system that implements the auth URL and attachment URL contract (see https://docs.sumoffice.com).
